_meta.description: Material-pressure rules with strict tier separation. Tier A = governing. Tier D = expert overlay.

tier_a_rules.rule: Titanium alloys SHALL NOT be used with LOX or GOX at any pressure, or with air above 5 psia O2 partial pressure.
tier_a_rules.note: This is a governing prohibition. The commonly cited 100 psia threshold is Tier D center practice that is LESS restrictive.

tier_d_heuristics.rule: Aluminum alloys: exercise caution above 200 psia in GOX service. Use Monel or copper alloy above 1000 psia.
tier_d_heuristics.note: Tier D — center practice, not governing standard. Display with Tier D label.

tier_d_heuristics.rule: Austenitic stainless steels: generally acceptable for GOX. Review promoted combustion data above 1500 psia.
tier_d_heuristics.note: Tier D — center practice. Stainless steels vary by alloy and form.

tier_d_heuristics.rule: Monel 400/K-500: preferred for high-pressure oxygen service. Nonflammable in most configurations.
tier_d_heuristics.note: Tier D — widely used and supported by test data, but the preference is center practice.

tier_d_heuristics.rule: Some center practices cite a 100 psia threshold for titanium. This is LESS restrictive than the governing MPR 67 (5 psia O2 partial pressure) and SHALL NOT override the Tier A prohibition.
tier_d_heuristics.note: CAUTION: This Tier D heuristic is LESS restrictive than Tier A. MPR 67 governs.
